notes.title: NanaScape VR - We want your feedback!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're considering a NanoScape VR version of the game.
Please let us know what you think, is it something you'd try?
All current Nano owners would get the VR version for free as a thank you for supporting the game.

Thanks!
Dan
